svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.cone-circle-ellipse-section-comparison", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "One right circular cone x\u00b2+y\u00b2=z\u00b2,0<z\u22646, shown twice as an axial x-z outline. Horizontal plane z=2 versus sloping plane z=2+x/2. Below each is the true in-plane section: circle or ellipse. Top triangles are axial projections of the same cone, not separate pyramids or complete perspective cut surfaces. External pairing/view key essential; independent selected lesson, not exact APH worksheet.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard; logical junctions de-duplicated, optional near-corner points omitted. Continuous Swell/ViewPlus paths shared; cone axial plane traces have explicit width and ViewPlus role differences.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard, logical junctions de-duplicated. Cone endpoints lie at analytic axial intersections; pyramid top apex is a true shared junction. Curves and boundaries are coarse sampled alternatives, not validated touch.
